The company demonstrates a very large asset base and strong profitability with an operating margin of 23% and a gross margin of 65%. However, its high total liabilities relative to equity and very low current ratio (0.53) suggest significant leverage and short-term liquidity constraints, typical of capital-intensive sectors like telecom or utilities, which constrains the rating to the lower-to-mid investment grade tier.

DECISION: BBB+
